text_block_list.text:
I guess I just have to eat it like 
this...! Then again... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainy! Won't you help me out? You're 
the only one I can rely on right now~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You'll help me, right? I knew I could 
count on you~! So, you see, these pickles 
right here... could you take a big bite 
out of 'em for me?♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaahn♪ Come on, open wide? Aaaaaaahn!
